app.title: Play against the bot
app.subtitle: The bot plays its hero in Tabletop Simulator and you play yours.
help.title: BEFORE YOU START
help.step1: Open Tabletop Simulator and load the tournament savegame (Unmatched Official Tournament Table).
help.step2: Sit in the White seat. The bot plays Green.
help.step3: Press START. The bot builds its panel on the table: play with its buttons.
help.step4: To finish, press STOP. The bot removes its panel and the floor labels. The game is saved: tick "Resume the saved game" to carry on another day.
hint.bot_pause: Empty: the configuration's (1 second). 0 turns it off.
hint.resume: Instead of a new game, carry on the last one where it was left.
hint.config: Empty: the bundled tournament table. Only if you know what you are doing.
opt.timing: Show in the console how long each message to TTS takes
status.playing: Playing. Use the bot's panel on the table.
status.checked: Check finished: the report is below.
status.stopping: Stopping: the bot is cleaning up the table...
error.tts_unreachable: Tabletop Simulator is not answering. Open it, load the tournament table and press START again.
error.tts_timeout: Tabletop Simulator is taking too long to answer. Is the table loaded? Try again.
error.tts_error: Something went wrong talking to Tabletop Simulator. See what the bot says below.
error.port_in_use: Port {port} is busy: another bot may already be running. Close it or change the ports in Advanced.
error.config: The table configuration could not be read. See what the bot says below.
error.cannot_start: The bot cannot start. The reason is below.
error.spawn: Could not open the bot program ({detail}).
error.crashed: The bot closed unexpectedly (code {code}). See what it says below.
error.same_hero: You and the bot cannot play the same hero.
error.ports: Ports must be numbers from 1 to 65535, and different.
error.ai_time: Thinking time must be between 0.1 and 60 seconds.
error.bot_pause: The pause must be between 0 and 30 seconds.
log.empty: What the bot says will show up here.
